fusions.name: Swarm Feed
fusions.desc: Looses 5 bites in a wide spread, each of which deals 3 damage. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Devouring Descent
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 24 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, harder the further it travels, up to 2 times its damage at maximum range. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Roiling Cloud
fusions.desc: Conjures a cloud that fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1 second.

fusions.name: Gorging Frenzy
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 30% of all damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
